content.text:
Catalog from sampling **50+** distinct `q*.png` crops across **2012–2026, pp, sap**. Layouts are structural (block order / asset needs), not topics.

---

## Core layouts

### L01 — `text_only`
**Order:** number → stem text → vertical A–D text  
**Assets:** stem no · options no · statements no  
**Examples:** `2014/q11.png`, `2018/q26.png`, `2016/q2.png` (plus optional “Given:” constants)  
**Freq:** very common

### L02 — `stem_diagram + text_options`
**Order:** diagram (top or mid) ↔ stem text → vertical text/number options  
**Variants:** diagram-first; text-then-diagram; text | diagram side-by-side (`2015/q19.png`)  
**Assets:** stem yes · options no · statements no  
**Examples:** `2012/q1.png`, `2013/q8.png`, `2014/q4.png`, `2025/q5.png`, `sap/q1.png`  
**Freq:** very common

### L03 — `stem_graph + text_options`
**Order:** intro text? → graph → question text → vertical options  
**Assets:** stem yes (axes graph) · options no · statements no  
**Examples:** `2015/q6.png`, `2020/q3.png`, `2018/q15.png` (graph + later statements)  
**Freq:** common

### L04 — `option_only_diagrams` (no stem image)
**Order:** text stem → A–D as diagrams (usually 2×2; sometimes 1×4)  
**Assets:** stem no · options yes · statements no  
**Examples:** `2012/q30.png`, `2021/q5.png`  
**Freq:** common

### L05 — `option_only_graphs` (no stem image)
**Order:** text stem → 2×2 graph options  
**Assets:** stem no · options yes · statements no  
**Examples:** seen in 2018 paper composites near `q4`/`q5`; same pattern as L06 without stem figure  
**Freq:** common (thermo/kinematics “which graph”)

### L06 — `stem_figure + option_diagrams`
**Order:** intro → stem diagram → prompt → 2×2 (or row) option diagrams  
**Assets:** stem yes · options yes · statements no  
**Examples:** `2013/q28.png`, `2019/q8.png`, `2022/q17.png`, `2017/q7.png` (1×4 FBD options), `2018/q20.png`  
**Freq:** common

### L07 — `stem_figure + option_graphs`
**Order:** intro → stem diagram/graph → prompt → 2×2 option graphs  
**Assets:** stem yes · options yes · statements no  
**Examples:** `2012/q18.png`, `2017/q13.png`, `2017/q23.png`, `2020/q12.png`, `2022/q24.png`, `2024/q7.png` (dual stem: diagram + graph)  
**Freq:** common

### L08 — `option_text_and_diagram` (each A–D)
**Order:** split stem with diagram → 2×2 cells each with **caption text + diagram**  
**Assets:** stem yes · options yes (text+image each) · statements no  
**Examples:** `2017/q27.png`  
**Freq:** uncommon

### L09 — `assertion_combination` (text-only)
**Order:** stem → (1)(2)(3) → A = “(1) and (2) only” etc.  
**Assets:** stem no · options no · statements **yes**  
**Examples:** `2013/q3.png`, `2017/q17.png`, `2021/q10.png`, `2023/q4.png`, `2025/q18.png`  
**Freq:** very common

### L10 — `stem_asset + assertion_combination`
**Order:** diagram/graph/photo → text → (1)(2)(3) → combo A–D  
**Assets:** stem yes · options no · statements **yes**  
**Examples:** `2012/q10.png`, `2013/q18.png`, `2019/q25.png`, `2020/q20.png`, `2020/q27.png`, `2021/q15.png`, `2022/q14.png`, `2022/q28.png`, `2015/q9.png` (stem graph), `2018/q5.png` (split text + diagram + combo)  
**Freq:** very common

### L11 — `graphical_statements + combination`
**Order:** stem text (± stem diagram) → **(1)(2)(3) are diagrams/graphs** in a row → combo A–D  
**Assets:** stem maybe · statement assets **yes** · options no · statements yes  
**Examples:** `2015/q14.png` (waveform outcomes), `2024/q28.png` (I–t graphs as statements)  
**Freq:** uncommon

### L12 — `formula / expression options`
**Order:** any stem → vertical A–D of formulas/inequalities  
**Assets:** as stem requires · options no (math text) · statements no  
**Examples:** `2012/q35.png`, `2016/q9.png`, `2022/q6.png`  
**Freq:** common (content type on L01/L02)

### L13 — `photo / realistic image in stem`
**Order:** text ↔ photo (sometimes annotated) → options (text, combo, or diagrams)  
**Assets:** stem yes (photo) · options vary · statements vary  
**Examples:** `2017/q12.png`, `pp/q2.png`, `2014/q1.png` (two product photos), `2014/q16.png` (photo + combo), `2017/q8.png` (photo + force overlays), `sap/q16.png` (photo + 2×2 ray diagrams), `sap/q30.png` (photoreal lab apparatus + combo), `2024/q10.png` (photo | annotated diagram side-by-side)  
**Freq:** uncommon but recurring

### L14 — `multi_panel_stem`
**Order:** fig (a)/(b) (stacked or side-by-side) → text → options  
**Assets:** stem yes (2+ panels) · options no · statements sometimes  
**Examples:** `2012/q15.png`, `2024/q16.png` (stacked wave grids), `2018/q30.png` (side-by-side circuits), `2021/q22.png` (side-by-side field grids), `2019/q7.png` q4 (two orientations), `2020/q11.png` / `2013/q17.png` (fig 1/2 particle positions)  
**Freq:** common

### L15 — `process_sequence_stem`
**Order:** horizontal sequence of setup stages → text → options  
**Assets:** stem yes (N panels in time order) · options no · statements no  
**Examples:** `2026/q5.png` crop includes q3-style beaker/sphere sequence  
**Freq:** uncommon

### L16 — `text_split_around_figure` (sandwich)
**Order:** intro text → figure → follow-up question text → options  
**Assets:** stem yes · options vary · statements vary  
**Examples:** `2016/q9.png`, `2020/q3.png`, `2017/q10.png`, `2025/q13.png`, most of L06–L08/L10  
**Freq:** very common (compositional pattern, not exclusive)

### L17 — `tabular / paired options`
**Order:** stem (± diagram) → column headers → A–D as paired values/phrases  
**Assets:** stem vary · options no (structured table) · statements no  
**Examples:** `2012/q20.png` (red|violet orders), `2019/q18.png` (two scenarios), `2023/q11.png` (momentum H|V), `2023/q21.png` (lens type|f), `2020/q11.png` (amplitude|speed), `2012/q6.png` (two force quantities)  
**Freq:** common

### L18 — `multipart_answer_table`
**Order:** diagram → stem ending “At which point could” → (1)…? (2)…? → A–D as (1)=point, (2)=point  
**Assets:** stem yes · options no (2-col answers) · statements as sub-questions  
**Examples:** `2012/q25.png`  
**Freq:** uncommon

### L19 — `columnar_parameter_scenarios`
**Order:** diagram → text → numbered rows under multi-column headers (charge, speed, B, …) → combo A–D  
**Assets:** stem yes · statements as table rows · options no  
**Examples:** `2026/q29.png`  
**Freq:** uncommon

### L20 — `option_grid_vs_vertical` (arrangement axis)
Not a full layout alone; options are either:
- **vertical list** (default for text/combo/formula)  
- **2×2 grid** (diagram/graph options) — `2012/q30.png`, `2017/q13.png`, `2019/q8.png`  
- **1×4 horizontal row** — `2017/q7.png`  
**Freq:** 2×2 common for pictorial options; 1×4 uncommon

---

## Status of your 12 known patterns

| # | Pattern | Verdict |
|---|---------|---------|
| 1 | text-only + text options | **Confirmed** (L01) |
| 2 | stem diagram/photo + text options | **Confirmed** (L02, L13) |
| 3 | stem graph + text options | **Confirmed** (L03) |
| 4 | option-only graphs | **Confirmed** (L05); also option-only **diagrams** (L04) |
| 5 | stem + option graphs | **Confirmed** (L07); also stem + option **diagrams** (L06) |
| 6 | stem diagram + options with text **and** diagram | **Confirmed** (L08) |
| 7 | multi-panel stem | **Confirmed** (L14); stacked and side-by-side |
| 8 | assertion/combination | **Confirmed** (L09–L11) |
| 9 | formula options | **Confirmed** (L12) |
| 10 | photo in stem | **Confirmed** (L13) |
| 11 | 2×2 vs vertical | **Confirmed** (L20); plus rare 1×4 |
| 12 | text split around figure | **Confirmed** (L16); often combined with 2–8 |

---

## Extra layouts worth modeling

| ID | Name | Why separate |
|----|------|--------------|
| L11 | Graphical (1)(2)(3) statements | Statement assets are images, not text |
| L15 | Process/sequence panels | Time-ordered multi-panel, not “fig a/b” |
| L17 | Tabular paired options | Needs headers + 2-field rows |
| L18 | Multipart point-pair table | Sub-questions + answer matrix |
| L19 | Columnar scenario table | Statements as parameter grid |
| — | Side-by-side text\|diagram | Space-saving L02 variant |
| — | “Given:” constants block | Extra stem text block after question |
| — | Photoreal lab circuit | Real apparatus photo as stem (`sap/q30.png`) |
| — | Photo + schematic dual panel | `2024/q10.png` |

---

## Modeling flags (practical)

| Flag | When |
|------|------|
| `stem_asset` | diagram / graph / photo / multi-panel |
| `option_assets` | A–D are diagrams or graphs |
| `option_has_captions` | L08 text+diagram cells |
| `statements` | (1)(2)(3) present |
| `statements_are_images` | L11 |
| `option_layout` | `vertical` \| `grid_2x2` \| `row_1x4` |
| `option_table` | column headers + paired cells |
| `stem_text_split` | figure between two text blocks |
| `stem_panels` | count / stack vs side-by-side / sequence |

**Rough mix from this sample:** L01+L09+L02+L10 dominate; L03/L04–L07/L14/L17 frequent; L08/L11/L13/L15/L18/L19 rarer but structurally distinct.

Review PDFs (not PNG lists): each year folder’s `combined.pdf` (and preprocess `anchor.pdf` where applicable).
